T1.implementation_approach: Initialize a version control repository, set up the project structure, and install necessary dependencies.
T1.notes: Ensure all team members have access to the repository.

T2.implementation_approach: Design a basic UI layout using HTML, CSS, and a frontend framework if needed.
T2.notes: Focus on a clean and responsive design.

T3.implementation_approach: Add a text input field and handle user input using JavaScript or the chosen frontend framework.
T3.notes: Validate input to ensure proper data handling.

T4.implementation_approach: Set up a backend server using a framework like Node.js or Django to handle saving notes.
T4.notes: Define API endpoints for saving and retrieving notes.

T5.implementation_approach: Use HTTP requests (e.g., Axios or Fetch API) to connect the frontend with the backend.
T5.notes: Ensure proper error handling for API calls.

T6.implementation_approach: Set up a database like MongoDB or PostgreSQL to store notes data.
T6.notes: Define a schema or structure for storing notes.

T7.implementation_approach: Integrate the database with the backend by connecting to the database and implementing CRUD operations.
T7.notes: Test database queries to ensure data integrity.

T8.implementation_approach: Test the text input functionality by simulating user input and checking for expected behavior.
T8.notes: Include edge cases like empty or invalid input.

T9.implementation_approach: Test the save notes functionality by sending data to the backend and verifying it is stored in the database.
T9.notes: Check for proper error handling and data consistency.

T10.implementation_approach: Deploy the application to a hosting platform like Heroku, AWS, or Vercel.
T10.notes: Ensure all environment variables are properly configured.
